summary.headline: Judging Illness and Death
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging delays, impediments, dignity, and success from the lord of the ascendant, the Moon, planetary conjunctions, reception, and the planets in the ascendant or relevant house. Chapter III begins a discussion of whether a sick person or querent asking about his life will recover or die.
